verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own AI Gateway that lets project code connect to popular AI models without managing API keys, so the core gateway capability exists. The evidence does not show the scale or shape the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of access to hundreds of models, documentation of a single unified endpoint/API surface, a model catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint

citations.quote: Connect to AI models through AI Gateway
Connect to popular AI models within your project code and connect to them seamlessly without managing API keys.
